description: Gripper Gen 7: reproduce Pollen's Grabette handheld gripper. Jake (voice): 'In the meantime I want another different agent working on Gen 7, which is basically [Grabette].' (transcript said 'hand it back'; read as Grabette from context; if Jake's reply says otherwise, follow that). Grabette repo: https://github.com/pollen-robotics/grabette (Apache-2.0; STL meshes in Git LFS, Onshape CAD and BOM linked from the README; Gripette is the matching robot gripper). Build Gen 7 in the Helping Hands design gallery as a faithful copy of Grabette, especially how the two fingers connect to the body (pivot/linkage/drive interface). Also write a short note describing that connection interface, so Jake can compare it with Gen 6 (the Generalist copy).

results.notes: Jake (voice) CORRECTION, replaces the Grabette reading above: 'Specifically what I want you to do there is delete everything else, just keep the yellow grippers for Gen 7, and just focus on getting the yellow part to look as close as possible to Generalist's yellow part.' Gen 7 is NOT a Grabette copy. Gen 7 = only the two yellow fingers, with no body, mount, camera, straps or drive, matched as closely as possible to the Generalist yellow fingers in cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_*.png (the photos are the source of truth; the best profile views are _two_hands.png, _robot.png and _top.png; use the Insta360 for scale). Start from the Gen 6 fingers if that helps. .

summary: Gen 7 of the Helping Hands design gallery should be a faithful copy of Pollen Robotics' Grabette handheld gripper, based on its open-source repo, CAD and BOM. Focus on how the two fingers connect to the body (pivot, linkage, drive), and write a short note on it so Jake can compare it with Gen 6.
